compatibility.detail: The U.S. manual identifies robot model QR1PES and dock EWFD16LRR; match both model codes before choosing parts.
Qrevo Pro uses a conventional single rubber roller. The verified Amazon fit listing is a third-party bundle that includes one roller; it is not a single-brush pack or a DuoDivide assembly.
The washable dustbin filter and disposable dock bag are separate parts. Do not order a bag as a robot filter or infer fit from a different Qrevo variant.
The round spinning cloths are separate from their plastic mounts and drive components; compare the cloth shape and attachment.

careTip: Let a rinsed washable filter dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it. Switch the robot off before servicing brushes or mop components.

questions.question: How do I identify the U.S. Roborock Qrevo Pro?
questions.answer: The U.S. manual lists robot model QR1PES and dock model EWFD16LRR. Check both labels before choosing parts.

questions.question: Does the Qrevo Pro use a DuoDivide main brush?
questions.answer: No. Roborock’s Qrevo Pro manual shows a conventional single main roller. The Amazon-linked third-party kit includes one rubber roller; it is a bundle, not a single-brush package.

questions.question: Are these all genuine Roborock parts?
questions.answer: The filter, black side brushes and dust bags are Roborock-branded. The main-brush kit and mop cloths are third-party products. DustMigo has not physically tested third-party fit or durability.

questions.question: Are Qrevo S Pro dust bags compatible with Qrevo Pro?
questions.answer: Do not assume so. Qrevo Pro and Qrevo S Pro are different variants. The linked Roborock bag title explicitly lists Qrevo Pro; recheck the exact model and 2.7 L pack on Amazon.
